content.title: Shannon M. Kent - Tunnel to Towers Foundation
content.text: Navy Line of Duty Death: January 16, 2019 Navy Chief Cryptologic Technician Shannon Kent was killed January 16, 2019, in a suicide bomb attack in Manbji, Syria. Kent, 35, was a Pine Plains NY native and the 9/11 terror attacks were a driving force behind her decision to enlist in the Navy. Kent served multiple tours of duty in both Iraq and Afghanistan and joined the Cryptologic Warfare Activity command when it was established in 2018. She was recognized many times for her work earning two Joint Service Commendation Medals, the Navy/Marine Corps Commendation Medal, an Army Commendation Medal, and a Joint Service Achievement Medal. The United States Navy posthumously promoted her from Chief Petty Officer to Senior Chief Petty Officer. She is survived by her husband Joseph Kent. who is retired US Army Special Forces, and two young sons Colten and Josh. Kent, who grew up in a service-oriented family her father Stephen J. Smith has spent his career in law enforcement and still serves his community as a Colonel in the New York State Police Department. Her uncle Vinny Plover, is a retired FDNY firefighter, a friend of the Siller family, and a long-time Foundation volunteer. The Tunnel to Towers Foundation has paid off the mortgage on the family home. PHOTOS PHOTOS
